rejected_reference_reasons.reason: Fixed-scale one-to-three-pixel rounding differs from persistent extra height after changing monitors.
Fixed-scale bounds inaccuracy is not the described monitor-transition height behavior.

ambiguity: screen is optional because the display transition may be relevant, while the failed observable is window geometry.
focus: Display transition versus generic DPI geometry similarities
rationale: A short window gains persistent extra height after moving between differently scaled monitors. The window sizing feature is direct, and screen is a defensible secondary component for the display transition. A Fiddle gist and precise monitor/drag steps are supplied. Fixed-DPI rounding offsets and frameless resize-hit insets do not establish this persistent minimum-height change after a monitor transition.
basis: Opening input plus earlier opening-state corpus; no evaluated policy output
